description: This file defines the 'Logout' controller class for the admin area of OpenCart, responsible for logging out users and redirecting to the login page.

classes.name: Logout
classes.description: Controller class for handling user logout in the admin interface, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the logout process by calling user logout, clearing the user token from session, and redirecting to the login page.
